connector.name: Scannd
connector.registryDescription: Trigger security scans and read reports/vulnerabilities via the hosted Scannd API. Free: 2 scans/mo.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package scannd-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.scannd, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCANND_API_KEY
env.description: Scannd API key (starts with sk_). Sent to the hosted API as the X-API-Key header. Get one at https://scannd.com; the free tier includes 2 scans/month.
